# American Lung Association

> The American Lung Association provides comprehensive lung health education, disease management resources, and community support for respiratory conditions including asthma, COPD, and lung cancer.

American Lung Association (lung.org) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to improving lung health and preventing lung disease through education, advocacy, and patient support programs. The site offers evidence-based information on respiratory wellness, disease prevention, and management of chronic lung conditions.

## Key Topics

- COPD (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease)
- Asthma
- Lung Cancer
- COVID-19
- Pulmonary Fibrosis
- RSV
- PAH (Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension)
- Lung HelpLine
- Better Breathers Club
- Patient & Caregiver Network
- Disease Prevention
- Disease Management
- Respiratory Wellness
- Air Quality
- Smoking Cessation

## Core Information & Resources

- [Home | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org): American Lung Association homepage with mission, programs, and advocacy initiatives
- [Lung Health & Diseases | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases): Main hub for lung health information, disease facts, and prevention guidance
- [Lung Disease Lookup | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/lung-disease-lookup): Directory of lung diseases with symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment information

## Disease Management & Education

- [COPD - Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/lung-disease-lookup/copd): Comprehensive COPD guide with management, treatment, and lifestyle resources
- [Asthma | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/lung-disease-lookup/asthma): Asthma overview with management resources and support communities
- [COVID-19 | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/lung-disease-lookup/covid-19): COVID-19 information including vaccines, treatments, and Long COVID support
- [Warning Signs of Lung Disease | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/warning-signs-of-lung-disease): Guide to recognizing symptoms of COPD, asthma, and lung cancer early

## Lung Wellness & Prevention

- [Lung Health & Wellness | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/wellness): Wellness guide covering prevention, exercise, vaccines, and respiratory health
- [Tips to Keep Your Lungs Healthy | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/wellness/protecting-your-lungs): Practical tips for lung health including smoking cessation and air quality
- [Respiratory Disease Vaccines | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/wellness/vaccines): Vaccine information for flu, pneumonia, COVID-19, and RSV prevention
- [Breathing Exercises | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/wellness/breathing-exercises): Breathing techniques for lung capacity, COPD, and asthma management
- [How Lungs Work | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/how-lungs-work): Educational guide to respiratory system anatomy and breathing mechanics
- [Lung Capacity and Aging | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/how-lungs-work/lung-capacity-and-aging): Information on lung capacity changes with age and spirometry measurements

## Patient Support & Community

- [Help & Support | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/help-support): Support resources including helpline, support groups, and patient networks
- [Lung HelpLine | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/support-community/lung-helpline-and-tobacco-quitline): Free Lung HelpLine for lung health questions and tobacco cessation support
- [LUNG FORCE | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/lung-force): LUNG FORCE initiative uniting women against lung cancer with awareness campaigns

## Community Engagement & Events

- [Events | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/get-involved/events): Community events including Fight for Air Climbs and Lung Force fundraising activities
- [EACH Breath Blog | American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/blog): EACH Breath blog featuring expert insights on lung health and air quality

## Support & Donations

- [Donate - American Lung Association](https://www.lung.org/donate): Donation and fundraising page for American Lung Association support
